The owner added the read-only permissions; spoofed crawler user agents from this machine had received 200, which proved nothing about verified crawler IPs.

crawler_access.reading: Crawlers, AI crawlers included, reach the site and are served 200. Access is not why vetagent.dev is absent from result lists; having one page with nothing specific to cite is the likelier cause, and that is what the reference pages address. Inferred from matching counts, not per-request logs: ClaudeBot's five 404s match its five /sitemap.xml fetches, made before the sitemap existed, and bingbot's three 405s match its three fetches of /mcp, which does not serve GET.
